tip.action.reset: Clear all filters and show the full list.

tip.action.account: Change your password and manage two-factor authentication.

tip.action.backup_download: Back up the database and all images as a ZIP file.
tip.action.backup_restore: Import a backup. All current data will be replaced.

tip.action.twofa_disable: Turn off two-factor authentication. Your password is required to confirm.
tip.action.twofa_regen: Generate new backup codes. The existing ones stop working immediately.
tip.entry.date: The day the maintenance actually happened – not the day you enter it.
tip.entry.asset: The object that was worked on. Leave it empty and the entry counts for the plant as a whole.
tip.entry.description: What was done? These lines appear in the PDF report.
tip.entry.notes: Internal observations, e.g. things to watch at the next visit.
tip.entry.comment: Free-form extra comment, for instance about consultations or material used.
tip.entry.operating_hours: Reading of the operating-hours counter at the time of maintenance – not how long the work took.
tip.entry.images: Attach photos. On a phone the camera opens directly; several images are possible.
tip.measure.value: The measured number. The unit comes from the threshold settings of that measurement.
tip.measure.temperature: Temperature of the sample in °C at the time of the measurement.
tip.measure.operating_hours: Reading of the operating-hours counter at the time of the measurement.
tip.measure.unit: Unit shown next to the value, e.g. mg/l.
tip.measure.min: Lower limit. Smaller values are flagged in red. Leave it empty if there is none.
tip.measure.max: Upper limit. Larger values are flagged in red. Leave it empty if there is none.
tip.asset.uid: Unique identifier of the object, e.g. the number on the shaft cover. It can only be used once.
tip.asset.name: Descriptive name under which the object appears in lists and on the map.
tip.asset.type: Plant, shaft or connection. The type determines the colour and symbol on the map.
tip.asset.install_date: Date of installation. Kept for the record and shown in the report.
tip.asset.next_maintenance: Date of the next service. With an interval set it is recalculated after every entry.
tip.asset.address: Location in words, e.g. street and house number.
tip.asset.latitude: Latitude in decimal notation, e.g. 48.208200. Required for the object to appear on the map.
tip.asset.longitude: Longitude in decimal notation, e.g. 16.373800. Required for the object to appear on the map.
tip.asset.comment: Lasting notes about the object, such as access, keys or special conditions.
tip.asset.images: Attach photos of the object, e.g. the cover, the installation or the type plate.
tip.filter.asset: Show only entries for one particular object.
tip.filter.activity: Show only entries with this activity.
tip.filter.parameter: Show only values of this measurement.
tip.filter.year: Pick a whole year. Choosing a year clears From and To – the two cannot be combined.
tip.filter.from: Earliest date. Filling this in resets the year selection to “All”.
tip.filter.to: Latest date. Filling this in resets the year selection to “All”.
tip.filter.text: Searches the description, notes and comment of the entries.
tip.admin.username: Name used to sign in. It cannot be changed later.
tip.admin.email: Optional, for information only. No e-mails are sent.
tip.admin.password_confirm: Enter the same password again to be safe.
tip.admin.role: Administrators manage users, thresholds, plant data and backups. Standard users record entries and measurements.
tip.admin.active: Unchecked, the user can no longer sign in; their existing entries are kept.
tip.admin.new_password: Leave it empty to keep the current password.
tip.account.current_password: Enter your password as it is right now to confirm.
tip.account.confirm_password: Enter the same new password again to be safe.
tip.twofa.code: The 6-digit code currently shown in your authenticator app. It changes every 30 seconds.
tip.map.add_shaft: Then click on the map to place a new shaft there.
tip.map.add_connection: Then click on the map to place a new connection there.
tip.map.add_pipe: Click two objects one after another to connect them with a pipe.
tip.backup.file: Choose a ZIP backup previously created by this app.
